name: auth-refresh
description:
NinjaOne tokens live 3600 seconds, so a long walk can outlive one mid-pagination. Page one (a full 500 rows) succeeds on the first token; the request for page two is rejected 401, which must trigger ONE re-authentication and a retry of the same page with the refreshed token rather than ending the run with a partial import. The retry answers a short page, ending the walk. Asserts the second token really is used (refreshed-access-token on the wire) and that all 502 devices import.

Invariant namespaced_ids is skipped because this integration emits the bare NinjaOne device id as the foreign id with no tenant or instance scope; that defect is reported separately rather than worked around here.

log_contains: ninjaone: bearer token rejected mid-run; re-authenticating
